summary: ISC Robin Andre Iversen (org. no. 996 717 267) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2011-03-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 80.010 (Etterforskningstjenester og private vakttjenester); it has 0 registered employees.
